macros.name: zvhyperlink
macros.doc: Inside the options of \zvLanguageSetup, and also inside the vcurrent and vother options of zref-vario’s reference commands, \zvhyperlink can be used to produce a hyperlink to the label of the reference.

macros.name: zvLanguageSetup
macros.doc: User interface for customization of “strings” and “formats” for ⟨language⟩.

macros.name: zvsetup
macros.doc: Package options can be set by means of \zvsetup.
